credits.title: Bonkey: The Mutated
credits.overview: An alien disease spreads like wildfire infecting a chain of unsuspecting victims. A man and his dog are all that stand in the way of containing the danger.

credits.title: On Again Off Again
credits.overview: Demanding careers. Family pressure. Exes. Finally, an honest portrayal of the highs and lows of modern romance in this story about the ones we can't stay with...but can't seem to let go.

credits.title: Dead Rush
credits.overview: Dead Rush is the end of the world, as we know it. Seen through the eyes of one  man - David - As he takes us through his journey: before, during and after the zombie outbreak.

credits.title: Blur
credits.overview: A beautiful executive's marriage is threatened when her darkest secret is revealed on a cross-country road trip with her husband.

credits.title: Dead Rush
credits.overview: Experience a zombie apocalypse first-hand, told entirely from the POV perspective of a young man as he struggles with his two friends to escape the hoards of the undead that chase them at every turn.

credits.title: Antisocial
credits.overview: Five university friends gather at a house party to ring in the New Year. Unbeknownst to them, an epidemic has erupted outside, causing outbreaks around the world.
